citation: Quilter, Jeffrey. 1989. Life and Death at Paloma: Society and Mortuary Practices in a Preceramic Peruvian Village. Iowa City: University of Iowa Press. 203 p. ISBN 978-0-87745-194-5.
notes: Secondary monograph on Paloma (Chilca Valley, central coast) Preceramic village burials; publisher frame ca. 5000–2500 B.C. transition toward more sedentary horticulture. Geographic focus is south of Norte Chico; used for coastal Preceramic research-history and comparative subsistence/mortuary context only — not as a Caral site report. Tier S.
